description: Run a query and write its complete table to a CSV file (RFC 4180, exact digits, formula-injection safe). Returns only the path, row count and byte size — the rows themselves never enter the conversation. The query must produce a table: use `| pluck(…)`, `| group(…)` or `| distinct`. The file is streamed and published atomically; an existing path is refused unless overwrite=true. Pass filePath to open and export an input file in one call, or docId to reuse an open document.

filePath.description: Input file to open now instead of supplying docId.

outPath.description: Where to write the CSV file.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing path atomically (default false).

query.description: A query producing rows or groups.

name: export_csv
